description.value: After a minute spent preparing, you embed a spoken message of 25 words or fewer—deliverable over as long as 10 minutes—into an unattended object you can see within range, along with a trigger condition of your choosing based on something visual or audible within 30 feet of the object. When that condition is met, the message plays back in your own voice at your original volume. You decide at casting whether the power ends after one playback or persists to repeat every time the trigger recurs, lasting until dispelled either way.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 2
